title: Writing a custom node with the V3 API
hook: A class with a schema and an execute method. The engine calls your node on a locked copy of the class, and that changes how you write it.

verified.claim: NodeOutput(block_execution=...) with no value, and a bare ExecutionBlocker return, failed with IndexError. A tuple holding a blocker stopped the next node, and the run still succeeded.
verified.ref: test nodes through PromptExecutor on a CPU

verified.claim: Inside the engine, execute runs on a clone of the class. Setting cls.calls fails with: Cannot modify class attribute 'calls' on locked class 'V3StateClone'.
verified.ref: comfy_api/internal/__init__.py:make_locked_method_func, with a test node through PromptExecutor

verified.claim: A dict held on the class is not protected: its count went 1, then 2.
A V1 node's instance lives across queues: __init__ ran once, and self.n went 1, 2, 3 over three queues with new inputs.
execute may return NodeOutput, a tuple, a dict, None or an ExecutionBlocker. Anything else raises Invalid return type from node.
comfy_entrypoint may be sync or async, on_load runs first, and get_node_list must return a list.
cls.hidden.unique_id held the node id in a real run, and fields you didn't ask for were None.

unchecked: Whether a dict on the class is safe across threads or async nodes. We just showed that the lock doesn't stop it, and that the cache can't see it.
We did not try async execute in a run for this lesson. The source awaits it through EXECUTE_NORMALIZED_ASYNC.
